ck: tatvaprakasikapavapota ‘atyatnapravano putva tasya sanihitatvata’ ityanuvyakyanan nanasi nitayaha– tatra cicnasoriti sukanastalatiputativicaranantaran atisuksnatyatnikacarcayan saktirpavati atastatvicarasyantinatvaniti pava atiputativisayasrutinan parasparavirotaniti tata ca sutrakrta sarvanapi vetavirotan parihartun tvitiyatyayasyaraptatvat srutinan parasparavirotaparihara-syavasarapraptatvacasya patasyantarpavalaksananantaryalaksana ca sankatiriti pava na cEvanasya patasyanekavisayatvenanekatvapatiriti vacyan; atyatnetaravisayatvenEkatvopapateriti apyupakatartatvaya iti srutyartatvenapyupakate paraparatatvarupartatvayenyatararte cakati srutinana-prananyapraptavanyarte paranatnakunapurtyatavanasvasaprasankatityarta hetvantaranaha– cakatsvarupa-nirnaya iti vicarapahulyapiprayena kranolankananiti sucikatahanyayena vartisyanana-krananusarenatiputatitEvaparanatnaciveti vaktavye civaparanatnatiputatitEvesviti civatisaptanan purvanipatotra civativicarasya pahvartavisayakatvena cicnasun pratyapyarhitatvatalpaksaratvacetyarta akasotpativisayeti ‘utpatyasanpavat’ iti purvasutraprakrtotpaterakasasanpantitvenatra vicaratanantarasankatiriti pava utpatinana veti atra pate srutisananvayena visno cakacanatikaranatvanayuktanuta yuktaniti cinta tatartan cakatkaranatvatyapitayakasrutirapranananuta pranananiti cintatvayanuvrti sarvatra trastavya atrakasa kinanutpatinanutotpatinaniti cinta tatartanakasasyotpatinatva-nanatitvasrutivirutan na veti tatartananatitvasruti kin nukyartota kOniti tatartan sa sruti kinanuputyatiyuktatvena niravakasota savakaseti tatartan viyata utpatinatve srutiyuktyati-rupapranananastyuta nastiti viyata utpatinatvenuputiyuktipahuvakvirotostiti nyaya-vivaranoktapurvapaksayuktinaha– akasasyotpatyankikara iti paktatvavarnananiti anatitva- srute svarupanatitvaparatvena paktatvavarnananityarta anyartatayeti praturpavartatayetyarta srirakaventratirtaviracita
